name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold and silver explorer headquartered in Reno, Nevada, focused on mineral exploration in the state of Nevada. The company holds multiple early-stage properties in Mineral County and the Quartzburg mining district, including the Loman, Agai-Pah, Belshazzar, and Swales claims. Nevada Canyon Gold is in the exploration stage with no current production and trades on the OTCQX marketplace under the symbol NGLD.
